انخدعت (form VII)
# اِنْخَدَعْتُ (inḵadaʕtu) /in.xa.daʕ.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْخَدَعَ (inḵadaʕa)
# اِنْخَدَعْتَ (inḵadaʕta) /in.xa.daʕ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْخَدَعَ (inḵadaʕa)
# اِنْخَدَعْتِ (inḵadaʕti) /in.xa.daʕ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْخَدَعَ (inḵadaʕa)
# اِنْخَدَعَتْ (inḵadaʕat) /in.xa.da.ʕat/: third-person
